description: Department of Census and Statistics - National Consumer Price Index October 2021
categorisation: This gazette content announces the National Consumer Price Index figure for October 2021, computed by the Department of Census and Statistics. This is a statistical announcement about economic indicators rather than government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or any of the specialized categories (Types 4-9). It falls under general administrative/economic matters that don't fit the other defined categories, making it Miscellaneous (Type 10).
